preservation_rule: Every original measured value below is reproduced verbatim as a citation. The historical file is byte-identical and remains the authoritative record of what was measured. No numeric field is edited into agreement with any later report.

correction.false_claim_in_historical_record: probe_2_sso_sized_names.note: 'isolates per-entry std::wstring heap allocation from copy/parse work'
correction.why_false: The short-name probe simultaneously (1) removed per-entry std::wstring heap allocation, (2) shortened the serialized payload by roughly 2.6 MB, (3) reduced shared-memory/page-fault work in CreateGenerationMapping/serializeWrite, and (4) reduced bytes copied on client parse. probe_1_no_name_at_all (66.651 ms total) is essentially as fast as probe_2 (73.71 ms total), so the two mechanisms are comparable in magnitude and this probe cannot separate them.
correction.also_false: interpretation.conclusion ('Roughly half of the measured first-generation total is spent materializing per-entry std::wstring names') is an over-attribution: the 62.678 ms figure combines allocation removal with payload/page-fault/parse reduction and cannot be assigned to name materialization alone.

probe_1_no_name_at_all.change: snapshotEntry.name.clear() instead of the projection arena name (unmodified export path)

probe_2_sso_sized_names.change: FileName() returns a 4-5 char extension instead of 'entry_<n>.ext' (full unmodified export/serialize/parse path, same entry and directory count)

later_pinned_measurement_reference.label: pin_sso
later_pinned_measurement_reference.method: interleaved randomized order, idle-gated, each repetition pinned to one logical core at high priority, 5 warm-up + 5 measured reps
later_pinned_measurement_reference.status: upper bound on the COMBINED effect (allocation removal + payload-size reduction), NOT an allocation-only speedup and NOT an expected retained gain for any production name representation
later_pinned_measurement_reference.note: These numbers belong to a different run than allocation-probe.json (pinned, after the harness move repair). The two runs are not averaged and not reconciled numerically; they measure different conditions. Both are preserved as measured.

campaign_consequence: The allocation-only question is answered by this change's tasks 5.1-5.3 (constant-payload isolation experiment), not by this record. Per spec requirement 'Allocation cost is isolated before a name-representation change', a gain inside the fresh same-binary noise floor is outcome C and no production name-representation change may be retained from the conflated probe.
